solver: CalculiX 2.23; reuse pinned f08 build, not f08 scientific acceptance

checks.name: 3D elastic affine patch
checks.field: u=(a*x,b*y,c*z); constant strain; sigma=lambda*tr(epsilon)*I+2*mu*epsilon; body force zero
checks.boundary: manufactured displacements; traction=sigma*n on complementary faces
checks.ladder: C3D20R h=4/2/1 mm; nonsingular positive elastic constants
checks.expected: affine solution reproduced to solver/roundoff tolerance, not a fake convergence order on zero errors
checks.pass_band: HUMAN_INPUT recommendation relative displacement/stress 1e-8 after solver tolerances are recorded

checks.name: smooth 3D elasticity MMS
checks.boundary: exact displacement on all faces; consistent volumetric source quadrature
checks.ladder: C3D20R h=1/4,1/8,1/16; exact interior volume quadrature
checks.gap: DC needs body-force/load quadrature adapter; a generic f08 mode test is not contact verification

checks.name: pretension and lock analytic two-spring check
checks.exact: bolt elongation=Fv/kb, member compression=Fv/km, total imposed shortening=Fv*(1/kb+1/km); phi=kb/(kb+km); Fb=Fv+phi*FA; Fc=Fv-(1-phi)*FA until separation
checks.checks: assembly forces; section-displacement sign/units against the complete compliance, not bolt-only elongation; remove force command, fix solved extension and retain residual state; compare serial history with same-state restart
checks.pass_band: HUMAN_INPUT recommend relative force 0.1% and displacement absolute 1e-6 mm; stiffnesses independently derived, no fit to result

checks.name: Coulomb contact control
checks.exact: uniform flat blocks at prescribed normal resultant N and tangential loading; sticking below mu*N, transition at mu*N; gap remains closed
checks.checks: no default tied contact; signed contact gap and relative tangential output mapping; elastic stick-slope displacement is not physical permanent slip
checks.pass_band: HUMAN_INPUT recommend transition resultant 1% with penalty/mesh study; no industry safety threshold

checks.name: force/moment and energy over full history
checks.checks: all external/reaction vectors about same origin incl eccentric pad, bolt/contact resultants, assembly-to-lock state, work/contact energy, nonlinear increments
checks.pass_band: HUMAN_INPUT recommend relative resultant 0.1%, work balance 1%; define absolute floors before acceptance; CCX RF includes applied loads, avoid double-count

checks.name: full 3D bracket contact/pretension
checks.ladder: mesh4/2/1 mm independently; contact normal/stick penalty 0.5/1/2x independently; load increments 0.1/0.05/0.025 independently
checks.checks: opening/slip envelopes, bolt/clamp force, selected volume stress, displacement and feasibility/pick agreement; full-history compared, not one endpoint
checks.pass_band: HUMAN_INPUT; Test Lead freezes bands, absolute floors and decision-regret tolerances before panel

Tier2.target: matched customer structural FE contact/pretension tool, e.g. Ansys Mechanical
Tier2.witnesses: separate public/retired non-hidden cases at contested boundaries; compare pointwise AND full-history decisions
